fields.label: Vendor Selection Mode
fields.options:
Nearest
Lowest Price
Highest Priority
Lowest Delivery Time
fields.description: How to pick a vendor when multiple sell the same product

fields.label: Default Commission %
fields.description: Default commission rate for new vendors

fields.label: TDS Rate on Commission %
fields.description: Withholding rate vendors apply to the commission they pay the platform (Income Tax Act 2058 s88). Settlement transfers payout minus TDS; the platform books the withheld amount as TDS Receivable.

fields.label: Platform Ledger Vendor
fields.description: The one Vendor site that keeps SaathiMart's own books (Entity A: commission income, platform coupon/loyalty expense, delivery income, TDS receivable). The hub itself runs plain Frappe with no ERPNext, so it cannot hold GL Entries — accounting.py pushes platform.* ledger events to this vendor's site instead, the same way it already pushes order/settlement events to any other vendor. This vendor still processes real customer orders and pays its own commission/TDS like any other — the two roles are independent.

fields.label: Cart Expiry (days)
fields.description: Guest carts are deleted after this many days of inactivity

fields.label: Abandoned Cart After (hours)
fields.description: Mark carts as abandoned after this many hours

fields.label: Free Delivery Above
fields.description: Global free delivery threshold (can be overridden per zone)

fields.label: eSewa Base URL
fields.description: Leave blank for default production/sandbox URL

fields.label: eSewa Payment Mode
fields.description: App Payment Mode entry to use for eSewa transactions (the app's own Payment Mode doctype — the hub has no ERPNext, so ERPNext's Mode of Payment does not exist here)

fields.label: Sandbox Mode
fields.description: Use sandbox/test endpoints for payment gateways

fields.label: Storefront Base URL
fields.description: Where shoppers land after payment (leave blank to use site URL)

fields.label: Payment Pending Expiry (hours)
fields.description: Cancel orders that remain unpaid after this many hours

fields.label: Points per NPR Spent
fields.description: How many loyalty points earned per NPR spent

fields.label: Point Value (NPR)
fields.description: How much each loyalty point is worth in NPR

fields.label: Max Uses Per User
fields.description: Limit how many times a single user can use the same coupon

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Shared secret for validating inbound vendor webhooks

fields.label: Retain Webhook Events (days)
fields.description: Delete Sent/Failed Webhook Events older than this

fields.label: Retain Sync Outbox (days)
fields.description: Delete Sent/Dead Sync Outbox entries older than this

fields.label: Retain Carts (days)
fields.description: Delete old Abandoned/CheckedOut carts older than this

fields.label: Retain Orders (days)
fields.description: Archive/delete delivered/cancelled orders older than this

fields.label: ⇄ ERPNext Integration
fields.description: Connect saathimart to a separate ERPNext site for daily accounting sync. Orders, payments, and customers are pushed once per day.

fields.label: ERPNext Site URL
fields.description: Full URL of the ERPNext site, e.g. https://erp.saathimart.com

fields.label: ERPNext API Key
fields.description: API Key from ERPNext user (User > API Access)

fields.label: ERPNext Company
fields.description: Company name in ERPNext, e.g. SaathiMart Pvt. Ltd.

fields.label: ERPNext Default Warehouse
fields.description: Default warehouse for Sales Order items, e.g. Stores - SM

fields.label: ERPNext Selling Price List
fields.description: Price list to use on Sales Orders

fields.label: ERPNext Taxes Template
fields.description: Sales Taxes and Charges Template name, e.g. Nepal VAT 13%

fields.label: ERPNext Delivery Charge Account
fields.description: Account head for delivery charges on Sales Orders, e.g. Delivery Charges - SM

fields.label: ERPNext Delivery Item Code
fields.description: Non-stock Item carrying the delivery charge as a line item on synced Sales Orders (a service of the logistics entity, not a tax). Created automatically in the ERPNext company if absent. Default: DELIVERY SERVICE

fields.label: Enable Daily Sync
fields.description: Enable the daily batch sync from saathimart to ERPNext. Disable to pause syncing.

fields.label: Mirror Critical Events to Redis Streams
fields.description: Also publish payment/order events to the vendor Redis Stream (durable second transport). The webhook path stays primary; the vendor consumes both idempotently. Requires Redis on the shared cache instance.

fields.label: Stream Redis URL
fields.description: Override only when the vendor consumes on a different Redis than this site's cache, e.g. redis://redis-cache:6379/1. Empty = use this site's cache Redis (same instance, same DB).
